pack.pack_name: Xiaohongshu Chemistry Cover Prompt Pack V1
pack.description: Mock-ready prompt pack for clean education chemistry cover images on Xiaohongshu.

items.prompt_content: Create a clean Xiaohongshu chemistry cover about {topic}. Use a 3:4 vertical layout, large readable Chinese title, simple lab glassware, soft white background, mint and cobalt accents, clear educational tone, no clutter.
items.negative_prompt: messy layout, tiny text, unsafe lab scene, dark background, realistic explosion

items.prompt_content: Design a vertical 3:4 educational cover image for {topic}, Xiaohongshu style. Put one bold title area at the top, one simplified molecular diagram in the center, warm paper texture, clean margins, readable Chinese text.
items.negative_prompt: overloaded text, low contrast, horror mood, complex unreadable diagrams

items.prompt_content: Generate a friendly science explainer cover for {topic}. 3:4 portrait, clean education visual system, one central metaphor object, short Chinese headline, calm colors, strong hierarchy, suitable for Xiaohongshu collection.
items.negative_prompt: stock photo look, dense paragraphs, chaotic icons, unsafe experiment
